title: Every scripted tank dodges
author: Blitzwing, Tank Designer-Developer
body: The Charger, Kiter and Sniper now step out of the way of incoming shells, each with its own reaction settings. Every balance target passes again: each side of the counter triangle wins 64–75% of its matches, the median match lasts 45 seconds, and no loadout averages above 60%. Evolved tanks still beat the new tanks 95.5%, first by dodging every shell.
next: Nye approves the rules change; then the nightly evolution restarts from generation 0.
